title: [22/6/2024] International applicants to the universities
prompt: The chart below shows the number of international applicants to the universities of one European country. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The chart gives information about how many students from four different countries applied to universities in a particular European country from 2004 to 2008.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while applications from China saw a significant decrease over the period, those from the USA and Japan showed an upward trend, and Russian figures remained relatively stable at a low level. In addition, throughout these years, China and American students consistently formed the largest groups of applicants, with their numbers being substantially higher than those from the two other countries.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding countries with the highest numbers, in 2004, the universities of the country received about 27,000 applicants from China, which was more than double the figure for their American counterparts, at about 13,000. Subsequently, Chinese applications declined steadily over the years, falling to about 15,500 by 2008. In contrast, there was an upward trend in American applications, reaching roughly 27,000 in the final year, making it the leading source country.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: As for the other countries, the number of Japanese applicants rose gradually from 7,000 to 10,000 between 2004 and 2008. Meanwhile, Russia had the lowest figures throughout the period, with minimal variation between 2,000 and 3,000 applicants annually.
